To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
DNA-polycation complexation is highly dependent on the polycation structure and the ionic conditions of the solution.
the structure and molecular mass of polycation play a significant role in the formation of complexes with DNA.
the transfection efficiency of the polycation-DNA complexes is highly dependent on both the cell type and the molecular mass of the polycations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the physicochemical and biological properties of DNA-polycations complexes and the effect of polycations structure on their properties.
the study of physico-chemical properties of complexes of DNA and cationic polymers, and their transfection efficiency.
the development of a new generation of non-viral vectors for gene therapy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the structure and molecular mass of polycations are important factors in determining the physico-chemical properties and biological activities of DNA-polycations complexes.
the structure and molecular mass of the polymer are the most important factors for complex formation and transfection activity.
the structure of the polymer is a very important factor for DNA-polycation complexation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
polycations with different structures and molecular masses form DNA-polycation complex, and their transfection efficacy is dependent on cell line and structure and molecular mass of polycation.

DNA-polycation interactions are highly dependent on polymer structure, ionic strength, and molecular weight of polymer and that DNA is protected in the complexes from protonation and disruption of secondary structure.
the most efficient transfection is achieved by using the polycations which form complexes with DNA at a low charge ratio, and which do not cause DNA denaturation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
DNA complexes with polyallylamine and polydimethylaminopropylamine are non-toxic and have high transfection activity.
the choice of a polycation with a proper molecular mass is a critical parameter in gene delivery.
the structure of the polycation is a crucial factor for DNA-polymer complexation.
